newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels train bomb scare blocks thousands.
newsitem.headline: Brussels train bomb scare blocks thousands.

text.p: A bomb hoax closed Brussels railway stations on Tuesday night, stranding 20,000 commuters for more than an hour, a railway spokeswoman said.
She said rail traffic was due to resume at 6.30 p.m. (1730 GMT).
An anonymous caller had earlier warned that a bomb would explode at six p.m. (1700 gmt) at the busy Gare du Midi (Zuidstation) station.
Police closed and evacuated all Brussels stations as a precaution.
"Luckily, the bulk of the daily commuters had already got their trains before the stations were evacuated," the spokeswoman said.
